## Bobathon 2026 Project Submission

Thanks for submitting your project! Please check the boxes below before opening this PR.

### Checklist

- [ ] I have copied `submissions/_template.md` to `submissions/my-project-name.md`
- [ ] I have filled in the `title`, `author`, `theme`, and `repo` fields
- [ ] The `repo` link works (it can be public or private)
- [ ] My file is in the `submissions/` folder
- [ ] I understand that submitting here does not transfer ownership of my project

### PR title format

Please set your PR title to:  
`Add submission: [Your Project Name]`
